title: A new organization has the setting off and no internal customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new organization created on the build.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Work Orders.
  2. Open the Customers list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Internal Work Orders" toggle is off.

Step 2:

  • No customer shows an "Internal" badge, and no customer was created by the release.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12295 (Story 13, Release day, seeding and migration)

  • S13-R1: “A one-time migration creates the starting categories for every organization (S1-R13): General Internal as the default Internal category; Warranty, Goodwill and Comeback as No Charge categories, with Requires the original work order on for Warranty and Comeback. Nothing is created in QuickBooks and nothing is turned on: the Internal Work Orders setting stays off for every organization.”
  • S13-R6: “Shops that keep an "Internal" or "Shop Fleet" customer today are not touched: the migration flags no customer and reclassifies no work order (Assumptions); S1-R11 handles it when the shop flags the customer.”
  • Key Decisions: “No feature flag. Rationale: the setting under Work Orders is off by default, so existing shops see no change until they turn it on; that is the release-day protection.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
